title: GitHub review batch can launch from a newly excluded repository
detail:
Updating repository filters rejects the first claim on its old revision, but a later candidate from the same stale batch can use the refreshed revision. Retain the spec edit fence while permitting desktop-only revision changes. Verified with an isolated mock provider.
Independently corroborated at cec7eaba2. Isolated regression receipts are attached to s-1hpv1w.
